function.text: INHBE encodes inhibin beta E chain. Annotated molecular activities include cytokine activity and hormone activity. It participates in negative regulation of adipose tissue development and cell surface receptor protein serine/threonine kinase signaling pathway.

function.text: INHBE encodes inhibin beta E chain. Based in part on similarity, inhibins/activins are involved in regulating a number of diverse functions such as hypothalamic and pituitary hormone secretion, gonadal hormone secretion, germ cell development and maturation, erythroid differentiation, insulin secretion, nerve cell survival, embryonic axial development or bone growth, depending on their subunit composition. It plays a central role in the regulation of adipose tissue lipolysis by preventing the influx of fatty acids from adipose tissue into the liver.
